headline: Building the next generation of lipid nanoparticles.
subheadline: A frontier biotechnology company developing a differentiated approach to particle design.

about.title: Rethinking particles from first principles.
body: Lipid nanoparticles have made a new generation of medicines possible. Yet delivery remains one of biotechnology's defining challenges.
BIZON Labs is building a new approach to LNP design, grounded in the belief that particles can be engineered with more precision, flexibility, and purpose.
about.origin: The name BIZON is a nod to bison, which are known for turning into a storm and moving through it rather than away from it. We take the same posture in science: walking directly toward hard delivery challenges with focus, patience, and conviction.

approach.title: A different way to build particles.
approach.body: Rather than treating formulation as an empirical search problem, BIZON is developing a more intentional framework for particle design. Our work focuses on understanding and shaping the physical properties that influence how LNPs behave.

pillars.title: Particle Design
pillars.body: Building LNPs around desired properties from the beginning.

pillars.title: Structural Control
pillars.body: Exploring how process innovations can influence LNP architecture.

pillars.title: Delivery Biology
pillars.body: Mapping the relationship between LNP architecture and complex biological systems.

pillars.title: Translational Readiness
pillars.body: Developing with real-world therapeutic applications in mind, and scalable by design.

team.title: Built by scientists, company builders, and a deep advisory network.
team.intro: BIZON Labs is led by co-founders Peter Sagmeister, Aniket Udepurkar, and Cedric Devos, bringing together experience across formulation, self-assembly, translational science, company formation, and biotechnology operations, with support and mentorship from a broader group of scientific, clinical, and company-building advisors.
